metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-154. - Number.
content.summary:
No more than two access points per property per street frontage shall be permitted,
               unless a traffic engineering study shows that additional access points are required
               to adequately handle the driveway volumes.
(Code 1981, § 30-139; Ord. No. 1544, § 8, 3-19-1979)
